newsitem.title: USA: Fort Bend to buy controlling stake in firm.
newsitem.headline: Fort Bend to buy controlling stake in firm.

text.p: Fort Bend Holding Corp said on Friday it has signed a tentative agreement with The Woodlands Corp to acquire a controlling interest in a mortgage banking firm.

Woodlands Corp and Fort Bend are forming New Mitchell Mortgage Co, a limited liability company that will originate and serve single family purchase loans, construction loans and commercial and multifamily real estate loans, Fort Bend said.
Woodlands will contribute certain mortage loans, its mortgage servicing portfolio and a portion of its mortgage banking unit, Fort Bend said.
Fort Bend will contribute cash for a 51 percent stake in New Mitchell, the company said. The dollar amount of the investment was not immediately available.
